extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic performance data were extracted from Figure 1b,c and the stability plot in Figure 1f. Figure 1d (Arrhenius plot) and Figure 1e (reaction orders) were skipped as kinetic analyses rather than requested performance datapoints; Figures 2–7 are characterization/mechanistic/schematic and were skipped. CO selectivity was not plotted in Figure 1c; only methanol selectivity was digitised, although the text states CO was the only by-product.
